records.source_title: Co-op Scheme - Winter 2026 at A&O Shearman
records.source_summary: A seven-month COOP internship in Riyadh with January and August intakes. The official page describes hands-on legal work across corporate transactions, disputes, research and drafting.
records.offer_summary: Seven-month Riyadh placement, January or August intake, mentorship and a monthly expense allowance.
responsibilities: Assist lawyers with legal research, drafting and documentation.
Support legal opinions, client presentations and team meetings.
Contribute to corporate transactions, disputes and other legal matters.
qualifications: Currently enrolled as an undergraduate law student.
A strong cumulative GPA and successful completion of the firm’s assessment are required.
Fluent spoken and written Arabic and English.
A university letter must confirm that COOP training is a graduation requirement.
records.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate Law student; Arabic and English; strong GPA; assessment; COOP must be a graduation requirement.
records.eligibility_source_text: The official posting requires current undergraduate law enrolment, Arabic and English fluency, a strong GPA, an assessment, and a university letter confirming COOP as a graduation requirement.
records.editorial_assessment: The clearest dated Saudi early-career opening in this feed. It provides direct exposure to international transactions and disputes; possible future trainee consideration is mentioned, but not promised.
records.provenance_notes: Official A&O Shearman job page and its linked application route were rechecked on 21 September 2026. The page states that applications close on 30 November 2026 at 5:00 p.m.

responsibilities: Work alongside Riyadh lawyers on complex regional and international matters.
Build practical commercial-law skills through training and mentorship.
Gain exposure across corporate, finance, capital-markets, disputes and regulatory work.
records.eligibility_summary: Students and graduates invited; degree, language, experience and licensing requirements are not stated by source.

records.editorial_assessment: A direct first-party route into Latham’s Riyadh early-career pipeline. Because it is labelled a general opportunity, the page does not establish immediate headcount, interview timing or a guaranteed intake.
records.provenance_notes: Official Latham & Watkins iCIMS posting retained in the 21 September 2026 backfill. It is a general opportunity with an on-page Apply action, not a dated vacancy.

records.source_title: Saudi Arabia Internship Programme | Pinsent Masons
records.source_summary: A three-month Riyadh internship for Saudi students and recent graduates, working alongside lawyers and business professionals. The official Saudi programme index marks internship applications open and the separate COOP programme closed.
records.offer_summary: Starts 11 October 2026; three months; rolling applications opened in September. Monthly allowance, amount not stated. Mentorship and practical legal exposure.
responsibilities: Work alongside Riyadh lawyers and business professionals.
Develop professional skills and commercial awareness; practice-group exposure depends on business requirements.
qualifications: Saudi national or long-term resident in Saudi Arabia.
Penultimate year or beyond of a law degree at a recognised Saudi university.
Minimum GPA of 2.5/4.0 or equivalent, achieved or on track.
Submit an up-to-date CV, cover letter and current academic transcript(s).
records.eligibility_summary: Saudi national or long-term resident; penultimate-year law student or beyond at a recognised Saudi university; minimum GPA 2.5/4.0 or equivalent.
records.eligibility_source_text: The programme states Saudi nationality or long-term residence, penultimate-year-or-beyond law study at a recognised Saudi university, and a 2.5/4.0 minimum GPA or equivalent.
records.editorial_assessment: A time-limited placement, not a permanent job. Future full-time or trainee-lawyer consideration is possible, not guaranteed. The internship and the closed COOP route must not be conflated.
records.provenance_notes: Employer Saudi index and internship detail returned HTTP 200 on 30 September 2026. Both Apply Now anchors on the detail page pointed to Oracle job 3672 in CX_1004. Rolling closure, start date and eligibility were read from that page. No exact posting day or allowance amount is supplied; the LinkedIn relative timestamp is not treated as an opening date.

records.source_summary: A Riyadh student internship listed as a current opportunity on Segal Law Firm’s first-party careers site. The role provides substantive legal exposure, research, structured learning and responsibility from the outset, with possible consideration for future opportunities.
records.offer_summary: Riyadh internship for current law students. No posting date, deadline, programme duration or compensation is stated on the verified vacancy page.
responsibilities: Work on real legal matters and conduct legal research.
Take meaningful responsibility within Segal teams from the outset.
Develop legal and commercial skills through practical experience and structured learning.
Gain exposure to different areas of legal practice and firm initiatives.
qualifications: Current law student at a recognised university.
Strong spoken, written and reading ability in Arabic and English.
Genuine interest in law and business.
Right to work in Saudi Arabia for the duration of the internship.
records.eligibility_summary: Current law student; strong Arabic and English; consistently strong academic record; interest in law and business; right to work in Saudi Arabia during the internship.
records.eligibility_source_text: The first-party vacancy states that candidates must be current law students at a recognised university, have a consistently strong academic record, be strong Arabic and English speakers/readers/writers, have a genuine interest in law and business, and have the right to work in Saudi Arabia for the internship.
records.editorial_assessment: A verified Saudi early-career route with substantive legal exposure and possible future consideration. The posting does not allocate interns to a specific corporate, finance or fintech practice, so practice-area relevance should not be overstated.
records.provenance_notes: First-party Segal careers index, Student Intern vacancy page and role-specific application form verified on 3 October 2026. Job reference SG-JOB-2026-0002. No posting date, closing date, duration or compensation is stated. No application was submitted.
